Anya: Quick sync — need final protocol for customer-guided rollforward + flag ownership for EU launch next week.
Mike: What exactly do we mean by "rollforward" here? customer requests we move them to a warmer variant/older model? :thinking:
Anya: Yes — customer ops can request a 'rollforward' to a different model/variant when they are impacted by capacity or quality regressions. This is different from a full rollback.
Rahul: Customer (AcmeCorp) explicitly asked: if we trigger a block for them, they'd like an expedited rollforward path. They have a signed support SLA and an SRE contact.
Sofia: SRE constraints: require telemetry gates before automated ramps. My recommended gate set: p95 latency sustained > 300ms for 5m OR error-rate increase > 200bps over baseline -> pause/hold.
Mike: For rollforward approval: product owner + eng lead + oncall ack (manual). If all three agree, we can do an accelerated ramp: 5% -> 30% -> 100% with 10m bake windows.
Anya: Proposed policy bullets:
- Ownership: feature-flag owner (product) + engineering rollover lead.
- Eligibility: customer must have active ops contact and opt-in via ticket or portal.
- Telemetry requirements: baseline window 24h, must not exceed quality regression thresholds for 30m during ramp.
- Escalation: SRE oncall can veto; if veto, fallback to previous variant and open incident.
- Audit: every rollforward tracked in the rollout log + automated email to customer ops.
Mike: Sample flag snippet we can add to the console (draft):
```
{
  "flag": "model.variant.rollforward",
  "schedule": "manual",
  "ramp": [1,5,30,100],
  "bake_minutes": 10,
  "owners": ["product:anya","eng:mike"],
  "veto_role": "sre-oncall"
}
```
Rahul: +1 on audit. Also we need a customer-visible TTL for the opt-in and a revert path if they change their mind.
Sofia: Ops note: add automatic snapshot of KV cache before rollforward so we can restore quickly if downstream degradation shows up.

Mike: Next actions: Anya to draft runbook + flag config in console; Sofia to add SRE veto checks to runbook; Rahul to confirm customer opt-in flow. Ping me when done, I can wire the automation.
Anya: Will send a short shiproom doc by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
